name: Business Origin Stories
bildvorlage: {einstellung} of {motiv} as the clear focal subject, {aktion}, in {ort}, {epoche}
bildstil_prompt: editorial illustration in textured semi-realistic painted urban open-world-game poster style, strong ink contours, warm sunset amber highlights and cool shadows, realistic proportions; painted, never photographic. Vivid, warm, inviting and richly filled, with visible emotion in faces and gestures; where fitting lived-in streets, warm haze, buildings true to the scene period and place. Original fictional character designs only; do not reproduce recognizable characters, distinctive outfits, logos or specific scenes from existing games. One clear focal action in the central 60 percent, coherent perspective and plausible period-appropriate props. Keep the important subject inside the center crop; quiet uncluttered top and lower areas for later captions. Natural anatomy, simple readable hand poses, distinct objects. Unlettered surfaces, without typography, numbers, signatures, watermarks, logos or collage panels.

erzaehlstimme.stil: deep cinematic trailer voice, serious and dramatic, deliberate pauses, builds suspense toward the twist
